text:
mochitest-thunderbird:
    description: "Mochitest browser-chrome-thunderbird run"
    suite:
        category: mochitest
        name:
            by-variant:
                a11y-checks: mochitest-browser-chrome-thunderbird-a11y
                default: mochitest-browser-chrome-thunderbird
    try-name: mochitest-browser-chrome-thunderbird
    target:
        by-test-platform:
            windows11-64.*:
                by-variant:
                    msix: target.installer.msix
                    default: null
            default: null
    treeherder-symbol: M(bct)
    built-projects-only: true
    loopback-video: true
    max-run-time:
        by-variant:
            msix: 5400
            default:
                by-test-platform:
                    linux.*64-ccov.*/.*: 9000
                    linux.*64-tsan.*/opt: 9000
                    macosx.*64-ccov.*/.*: 10800
                    windows.*-ccov.*/.*: 10800
                    default: 3600
    variants:
        - msix
        - a11y-checks
    run-on-projects:
        by-variant:
            msix:
                by-test-platform:
                    windows11-64.*: built-projects
                    default: []
            a11y-checks:
                by-test-platform:
                    linux.*64/opt: built-projects
                    default: []
            default: built-projects
    tier:
        by-test-platform:
            .*-asan.*: 2
            .*-ccov.*: 2
            .*-tsan.*: 2
            macosx1100.*: 2
            windows11.*: 1
            default: default
    chunks:
        by-test-platform:
            linux.*64-asan.*/opt: 16
            linux.*64-tsan.*/opt: 15
            windows1.-64.*-asan.*/opt: 9
            windows1.*-ccov.*/.*: 9
            .*/debug: 11
            default: 7
    mozharness:
        script: desktop_unittest.py
        mochitest-flavor: browser
        chunked: true
        config:
            by-test-platform:
                windows.*:
                    - unittests/win_unittest.py
                    - unittests/thunderbird_extra.py
                macosx.*64.*:
                    - unittests/mac_unittest.py
                    - unittests/thunderbird_extra.py
                linux.*:
                    - unittests/linux_unittest.py
                    - remove_executables.py
                    - unittests/thunderbird_extra.py
